resolution.title: Attach the combined ALLMAPS evidence
resolution.detail: The paper says JoinMap, Rascaf, and AGOUTI evidence was appended for ALLMAPS, but does not report the conversion commands. Attach the reviewed BED file instead of guessing that transformation.

recipes.title: Prepare reviewed ALLMAPS evidence
recipes.summary: Attach the combined evidence BED and weights file without inventing an undocumented conversion.
steps: Review the paper and supplements for the JoinMap, Rascaf, and AGOUTI evidence conversion.
Create or obtain the combined ALLMAPS BED using that documented transformation.
Attach the matching weights file and record any assumptions in the node note.
